name: marketing-empty-content
title: Empty Content
description: Engagement-oriented placeholder states for marketing and eCommerce pages, with no-search-results, coming-soon countdown, related-content suggestions, and out-of-stock messaging variants.
useWhen: A product catalog search returns no matching results and you want to retain the user with alternative content suggestions.
A page or feature is not yet launched and you need a coming-soon holding page with optional notification signup.
A product is out of stock and you want to offer related alternatives rather than a dead end.
avoidWhen: The empty state is inside an application UI (dashboard tables, form lists) — use application empty-states instead.
The page has enough content to show something useful — do not render empty state components preemptively.
The absence of results indicates a permanent product gap — address the catalog instead of adding a placeholder.
responsiveBehavior: Empty content sections center vertically and horizontally within their container at all viewport sizes. Coming-soon countdown timers reflow to a 2×2 grid on mobile from a 4-column row on desktop.
accessibility: The primary heading of the empty state must clearly explain what happened (e.g., 'No results for "blue shoes"').
Related content suggestions and CTA links must have descriptive labels — not 'click here'.
Coming-soon countdown timers should use <time datetime> elements with aria-live for live countdown updates.

variants.title: No search results
variants.description: Empty state for zero-results search pages with an icon, 'No results found' message, and suggested alternative actions to keep users engaged.
accessibility: Heading clearly states that no results were found; alternative actions are meaningful links, not placeholder text.

variants.title: No search results (Dark)
variants.description: No-search-results empty state adapted for dark marketing page surfaces.
accessibility: Heading and action link text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark empty state backgrounds.

variants.title: No search results (alternative)
variants.description: Alternative no-results layout with a different visual treatment or messaging style — for A/B testing empty state engagement.
accessibility: Alternative layout must still clearly communicate the empty state to screen readers via heading text.

variants.title: No search results (alternative) (Dark)
variants.description: Alternative no-results layout adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Alternative layout text and icons must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Coming soon
variants.description: Coming-soon placeholder page with a countdown timer and optional email notification signup to capture leads before launch.
accessibility: Countdown timer uses <time> elements; email signup field must have a visible label; live countdown updates use aria-live='polite'.

variants.title: Coming soon (Dark)
variants.description: Coming-soon page adapted for dark marketing surfaces with countdown timer and email capture visible on dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Countdown numbers and email input must meet contrast requirements on dark page backgrounds.

variants.title: Related content
variants.description: Empty state that replaces missing results with a 'You might also like' grid of related articles, products, or categories to retain engagement.
accessibility: Section heading must announce that the original search had no results before presenting alternatives.

variants.title: Related content (Dark)
variants.description: Related-content alternative grid adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Related content links and images must meet contrast requirements on dark empty state backgrounds.

variants.title: No stock
variants.description: Out-of-stock product page placeholder with a message, notify-me email capture, and links to similar in-stock alternatives.
accessibility: Out-of-stock status must be communicated via heading text; notify-me form field requires a visible label.

variants.title: No stock (Dark)
variants.description: Out-of-stock placeholder adapted for dark eCommerce marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Out-of-stock heading and form field must meet contrast requirements on dark page backgrounds.
